# Kustron

> Kustron is a CLI that turns one declarative file (kustron-env.yaml) into a
> running local development environment: it provisions its own k3d cluster
> and container registry, builds images from local source or public git
> repos, deploys apps (source, existing images, or Helm charts) with
> deterministic content-hashed builds, waits for healthchecks, and tears
> everything down with env destroy — without ever mutating the user's
> kubectl context.

Coding agents should read AGENTS.md first: it contains the complete
operating runbook (non-interactive flags, machine-readable `--json`
contracts, and the exit-code semantics agents gate on).

## Reference

- [Website](https://itsmunim.github.io/kustron/): overview, quickstart, FAQ
- [Features & examples](https://itsmunim.github.io/kustron/features.html): every feature with a concrete kustron-env.yaml example
- [AGENTS.md (agent runbook)](https://github.com/itsmunim/kustron/blob/master/AGENTS.md): how coding agents provision, test, and tear down environments with kustron
- [SKILL.md (contributor skill)](https://github.com/itsmunim/kustron/blob/master/SKILL.md): architecture and conventions for agents working on the kustron codebase itself
- [README](https://github.com/itsmunim/kustron/blob/master/ReadMe.md): install (incl. install.sh), quickstart, command reference
- [Schema reference](https://github.com/itsmunim/kustron#kustron-envyaml): every field of kustron-env.yaml; also available as `kustron env show-spec`
- [Comparison with tilt.dev](https://github.com/itsmunim/kustron/blob/master/docs/comparison.md): verified-vs-docs capability table
- [Source tree](https://github.com/itsmunim/kustron/tree/master/src): TypeScript (commander.js CLI + zod-validated yaml schema in src/core/env-file.ts)
